{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders (by revenue): {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check if any QA orders are in 'completed' status
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
qa_in_completed = df[qa_mask & completed_mask]
print(f'QA orders in completed: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

# Check if any QA orders have converted == 1
qa_converted = qa_in_completed[qa_in_completed['converted'] == 1]
print(f'QA orders that are completed AND converted: {len(qa_converted)}')

# Remove all QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]
df_clean_completed = df_clean[completed_mask]

# Check that no QA orders remain in the completed dataset
assert len(df_clean_completed[df_clean_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']) == 0

# Now compute raw conversion rates by channel
grouped = df_clean_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
raw_email_rate = grouped['email']
raw_paid_search_rate = grouped['paid_search']
difference_raw = raw_email_rate - raw_paid_search_rate

# Print all required values
print(f'Raw conversion rate for email: {raw_email_rate}')
print(f'Raw conversion rate for paid_search: {raw_paid_search_rate}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference_raw}')"}
